reviewedSummary.zh: 计划从由布院当天往返。把缆车和户外观景优先安排在白天，顺序根据能见度灵活调整。美食可考虑鸡天妇罗、琉球风味腌生鱼片、团子汤及当地海鲜；也可视市场营业时间，买鱼回住宿烹调。偏好私人入浴；砂浴和竹编体验目前仅为想法，尚未选定场所。

Food ideas include toriten, ryukyu-style marinated sashimi, dangojiru and local seafood. Buying fish to cook at the accommodation is another possibility, subject to market opening times. Private bathing is preferred; sand bathing and bamboo crafts remain ideas without selected venues.

reviewedSummary.zh: 以轻松的温泉村住宿为主：自由散步、看河畔景色、逛咖啡馆和小吃店。商店与咖啡馆可能较早关门，购物和小吃尽量安排在白天。住宿偏好步行方便、价格合理，并含晚餐和早餐。一处林间或山边景观温泉值得考虑，但公共裸浴会影响选择，私人入浴方式需确认。户外活动安排在白天，离开时给阿苏留足时间。瀑布和平野台均为可选，不必全部打卡。提前确认正餐安排，不依赖晚上临时找餐厅。住宿标价为此前记录的每位成人每晚含两餐、税前起价，并非当前报价或已确认有房。
reviewedSummary.en: The priority is a relaxed village stay: walking, riverside scenery, cafés and snacks, with time to explore independently. Shops and cafés may close early, so browse and buy snacks during the day. Prefer reasonably priced accommodation within convenient walking distance, ideally with dinner and breakfast included. One scenic forest or mountainside bath may be worthwhile, but communal nudity is a consideration and private options need checking. Use daylight for outdoor activities and leave enough time on departure for Aso. Waterfalls and Hiranodai are optional additions, not a checklist. Confirm meal arrangements rather than relying on finding dinner late in the village. Accommodation prices shown are earlier published starting-rate references per adult per night with two meals, before tax; they are not current quotes or confirmed availability.

reviewedSummary.zh: 计划从黑川经阿苏观景自驾前往熊本。天气好且只能安排一处主要景点时，优先草千里；时间允许再加大观峰，欣赏盆地全景。已保存的大观峰至草千里道路可达区域路线约 28 公里，模型车程约 30 分钟；规划时建议预留约 40–50 分钟，不含游览、停车及延误，并非实时导航估计。十二月白昼较短，日落大致在下午五点左右；若午饭后才离开黑川，尤其草千里还需 1–2 小时，两处都会较赶。中岳更可能仅开车经过附近景观，不专程参观火口。美食可考虑阿苏赤牛丼，尚未选餐厅。出行前再核实冬季路况和火口开放限制。
reviewedSummary.en: Planned as a scenic drive from Kurokawa through Aso toward Kumamoto. Kusasenri is the first choice if there is only time for one main stop and the weather is nice; add Daikanbo for the broad caldera panorama if time allows. The saved road route between Daikanbo and the Kusasenri road-access area is about 28 km, with a modelled driving time of about 30 minutes; budget roughly 40–50 minutes for planning, excluding sightseeing, parking and delays. This is an estimate, not live navigation. December daylight is limited, with sunset roughly around 5 p.m.; leaving Kurokawa after lunch makes both stops harder to fit, especially with 1–2 hours at Kusasenri. Nakadake is most likely just a drive through the nearby landscape, not a dedicated crater visit. Akagyu-don, the local red-beef rice bowl, is a food idea without a selected restaurant. Recheck winter road conditions and crater access closer to the visit.

description.zh: 可选景观停留点：宽阔水帘垂落在林间溪谷，后方步道开放时可从瀑布背面观赏。现场预留约 30–45 分钟，另加车程。决定绕道前需核实开放情况及预约要求。
description.en: Optional scenery stop: a broad curtain of falling water framed by a wooded ravine, noted for views from behind the waterfall when that path is accessible. Allow around 30–45 minutes on site, plus driving. Check access and reservation requirements before including this detour.

location.pointRepresents: Waterfall reference, not parking or trail entrance.

planningNotes.text: Optional, not mandatory; could visit on departure and reduce Aso time.

description.zh: 可选景观停留点：两道瀑布从林间溪谷流下，在下方汇合。适合作为较短的摄影绕行，现场预留约 20–30 分钟，另加往返时间；以不挤压温泉街游览和后续车程为前提。
description.en: Optional scenery stop: two waterfalls descend through a wooded ravine and meet at the confluence below. A shorter photography detour, allowing around 20–30 minutes on site plus travel. Include only if it leaves enough time for the village and onward drive.

location.pointRepresents: Waterfall reference, not parking or trail entrance.

planningNotes.text: Optional, not mandatory; could visit on departure and reduce Aso time.

description.zh: 欣赏乡间与山地风景的高原展望点，既有资料中也称为「恋人之丘」。目前为可选活动，尚未确定安排。开车短访与较长的乡间步行是两种不同安排，步行路线及所需时间尚未确认。
description.en: A highland viewpoint for countryside and mountain scenery, also referred to as Lovers Hill in the saved notes. An optional outing rather than a selected stop. A driving visit and a longer countryside walk would be different activities; no walking route or duration is confirmed yet.

location.pointRepresents: Hiranodai viewpoint reference; walking access not calculated.

planningNotes.text: Keep on map for later pruning; not yet selected.
Earlier suggested as a walking excursion, potentially around three hours on foot; car visit could be shorter.

description.zh: 阿苏火山口盆地北缘的全景展望点，可感受盆地规模及周围山景。可作为从黑川经阿苏前往熊本途中的停留点，从停车处需步行一小段。预留约 30–60 分钟观景和摄影。如果天气好但只够安排一处主要景点，优先选择草千里。
description.en: A panoramic viewpoint on the northern rim of the Aso caldera, offering a sense of the basin’s scale and its surrounding mountains. A possible stop on the drive from Kurokawa through Aso toward Kumamoto, with a short walk from parking. Allow around 30–60 minutes for sightseeing and photography. If time permits only one main stop in good weather, prioritize Kusasenri.

location.pointRepresents: Viewpoint reference, not a parking entrance.

planningNotes.text: Keep as one of the three Aso POIs; likely stop on the Kurokawa-to-Kumamoto route.
Complements Kusasenri by showing the overall scale of the caldera.

description.zh: 开阔草原与池塘相映，可眺望阿苏中央火山群。天气好且只能安排一处阿苏主要景点时，优先选择这里，以摄影和轻松散步为主。附近也有博物馆、咖啡馆及餐饮可选。根据步行和额外游览内容，预留约 1–2 小时。
description.en: An expansive grassland landscape with ponds and views toward Aso’s central volcanic peaks. Our first choice if we make only one main Aso stop and the weather is nice: photography and a relaxed walk are the focus. A museum, cafés and dining are nearby if wanted. Allow around 1–2 hours, depending on walking and additional sightseeing.

location.pointRepresents: Representative grassland location, not a parking entrance.

planningNotes.text: Keep as one of the three Aso POIs; likely stop.
Complementary to Daikanbo: experience the volcanic highlands from within the landscape.

description.zh: 阿苏的活火山口，开放时可能看到蒸汽喷口和火口湖。本次优先级较低，更可能只是开车经过附近火山景观，不专程参观火口。火口本身并非开车经过就能看到的景点，近距离参观需要另行安排交通和时间。若改变计划，暂预留现场约 30–60 分钟，另加往返时间，并核实官方限制。标记为火口位置，而非游客入口。
description.en: Aso’s active volcanic crater, with possible views of steam vents and the crater lake when accessible. Low priority for this trip: most likely only a drive through the nearby volcanic landscape, without a dedicated crater visit. The crater itself is not a drive-by viewing point; a closer visit would require separate access and time. If plans change, tentatively allow 30–60 minutes on site plus access time, and check official restrictions. The pin marks the crater, not a visitor entrance.
